title: Inline guide strip
summary: On the first visit a navy strip sits between the intro sentence and the board with three board-style tiles and one line each: PIVO "Odpovídejte jedním slovem", a blue "?" "Otazník dává nápovědu", a red X "Pět chyb a konec", plus a "Rozumím" button that hides it for good. No modal; the player can start typing straight away.
tradeoffs: On a phone the strip pushes the board and the input about 170px down on the first visit; it does not explain scoring or the clue costs in detail.
